svg.title: AdFection - Discover-Tech ads delivering Candiru zero-click spyware
svg.desc: Two-lane kill chain. Left lane: 1 Discover-Tech bids and wins an ad slot, 2 the ad script contacts a NOAS getAd server, 3 eligibility check on IP and advertising ID, 4 tasked script or 1x1 iframe delivered, 5 Candiru validator probes the device, 6 profiling and infection of a Windows host with a COM-hijack DLL, 7 Candiru C2 contact. Right lane: attribution, Controlium control panel, exposed data, indicators, detection anchors and caveats. Critical badges on delivery, infection and C2.
svg.text: AdFection: targeted ads as a zero-click spyware pipeline
Vendor: Citizen Lab - Date: 2026-10-26 - Cluster: Candiru via Discover-Tech (high) - Day 125
VICTIM SIDE: AD IMPRESSION TO IMPLANT
ACTOR, INFRASTRUCTURE AND DEFENDER VIEW
Discover-Tech wins an ad bid
Real-time bidding places the ad in 75,373 apps and
120,768 websites (Mar-Jun 2026); ad renders even in background
Victim only needs the ad to load, no click or message
Hunt H3 Sigma 03
Ad script calls a NOAS getAd server
Script tag sends cookie ID or advertising ID and cookies
Hosts: noas.mtrtb.com, noas.powerium.net, events.myweb3id.io
Discover-Tech never hands the malicious code to ad vendors
/getAd /jsConfig
Sigma 03 KQL k3 Suricata 6430004
Eligibility check on IP and device ID
Server decides if this visitor is a tasked target
Not eligible: 0-byte reply. Eligible: JavaScript, once per target
Encrypted ad-URL parameters tie the click to the impression IP
T1592 OpSec V3 per-user key
Hunt H3
Tasked 1x1 iframe or script delivered
Operator picks Ad URL or Script in the Controlium panel
Iframe loads a Candiru-linked profiling URL
sincereaccertain.com distributed via ads from Apr 2025
Sigma 02 KQL k1
Candiru validator probes the device
Initial device check before any implant is sent
Fingerprint V1: Apache header order; keyadapter.com, sharethere.net
303 more domains and 319 IPs in the Citizen Lab appendix
Sigma 02 Suricata 6430003 Hunt H1
Windows host infected, COM-hijack persistence
Al Jazeera DLL SHA256 255869de...5cc8, 48-byte XOR strings
Persistence by COM hijack with a different DLL than 2021
At least 45 Al Jazeera devices in 2024 and 2025
Sigma 04, 05 KQL k2 Hunt H2 YARA 1
Candiru C2 contact
Hardcoded C2 fearevolve.com and jobmarcher.com
Connectivity check to www.google.com and www.microsoft.com
Fingerprint C1: nginx, keep-alive, empty reason phrase
Sigma 01 Suricata 6430001-2 Hunt H1
A
Attribution: Candiru, high confidence
Al Jazeera sample resembles the 2021 Candiru chain
Discover-Tech linked to Candiru by OpSec decoder on myipinfo.io
Bindecy and Intelos also use Controlium; DARK CARTOGRAPHER pending
Citizen Lab names no government customer
Citizen Lab 2026-10-15
B
Controlium: ad-tech panel for mercenaries
Target by advertising ID, browser ID or IP; tag generator,
campaign caps, domain and app allowlists, OpSec limits
Auth0 JWT ignored: backend trusted an unsigned user object
Exposed /csv-download: 128 days of logs, 120 usernames
INTEGRITYPRESALE1 INTEGRITYPRESALE2
C
Exposed bid data shows reach
3.77 billion bids, 441.95 million wins, about 109,091 USD
NOAS-script ads: 718.7 million bids in 161 countries
Impressions seen on NATO, UN, EU and defence networks
Confiant: DoD, IAEA, ICC; not proof of compromise
druid.mtrtb.com ppv2.mtrtb.com
D
Indicators and their limits
Candiru: fearevolve.com, jobmarcher.com, keyadapter.com
Controlium: mtrtb.com, powerium.net, myweb3id.io
Ad-tech domains also serve benign ads: use as exposure signal
Implant domains are 2024-2025: search long DNS history
iocs.csv 59 rows YARA 2 rules
E
Detection anchors
Long-window DNS for C2 and validators (Sigma 01-02, H1)
Ad domain then validator then C2 in one hour (KQL k3)
Per-user COM hijack to a user-writable DLL (Sigma 05, H2)
Exposure map of Controlium lookups (Sigma 03, H3)
Sigma 01-05 KQL k1-k3 Suricata 6430001-4
F
Response and caveats
Google, IAB Europe, Beeswax delisted Discover-Tech in Oct 2026
Vungle paused access; Eskimi blocked accounts and domains
Marczak: at-risk users should block ads or disable ad tracking
No CVE or exploit named; mobile exploit chain not published
Hunts H1 H2 H3
Detection anchors: Candiru C2 and validator DNS history, ad-then-validator-then-C2 sequence, COM hijack to user DLL, Controlium exposure
Rules in this folder: Sigma 01-05, KQL k1-k3, YARA 2 rules, Suricata sids 6430001-6430004, PEAK hunts H1-H3.
No CVE or exploit published. Implant indicators date from 2024-2025; Controlium hosts are ad-tech and need context.
Act: search long DNS history, map Controlium exposure for at-risk users, block the domains, image any host with a C2 hit.
